_meta.purpose: Persistent cognitive core for all Gazzetta cloud agents — owner directives, never-again lessons, and design tokens. Read at runtime by cdo-auditor, memory-synthesizer, and any agent that touches the Gazzetta pipeline.

owner_directives: Telegram posts must use psychological hooks to drive traffic — every post must earn the click.
The user experience must be polished and cohesive — broken buttons, invisible text, and clunky navigation are total system failures regardless of pipeline health.
Never claim operational success from build exit codes alone — verify live UX via browser_vision + getComputedStyle() at minimum.
The contradiction IS the signal — every story must name the asset, the flow, and the divergence from consensus.
Data must be dynamic — no hardcoded digits anywhere in HTML. All numbers flow from the pipeline.
Pure white (#FFFFFF) background everywhere. Gold (#D4AF37) accents must be immediately visible. No off-white tints.
Single-column, frameless layout. All story cards always expanded. No collapsible sections.
Stage 5 post-deploy review (3 fresh-eyes personas on live URL) is NON-NEGOTIABLE before any 'done' claim.
never_again_list: Never report success based on local compilation if CDN caching is blocking the live view.
Never publish stories from the previous day on Telegram.
Never claim 'All Systems Operational' when the CDO auditor shows FAIL (4+ design violations).
Never use sed/awk/regex on HTML, CSS, or JS files — patch() tool only.
Never deploy to GCS without explicit C-Suite approval.
Never skip Stage 5 post-deploy review — it has caused 4 regressions in a single cycle (v22.16).
Never commit CSS changes without a cache-busting timestamp on script/style imports.
Never trust browser_vision for color verification — always cross-check with getComputedStyle().
Never use the Hermes venv gsutil for GCS operations — only the Devvit SDK authenticated gsutil.
Never leave design tokens stale in cdo_audit.py when the live design changes.
Never assume a container rebuild fixed the pipeline — verify execution logs, not just build exit codes.
